# Breakdown by season phase
print("\n\n=== SUMMARY BY SEASON PHASE ===")
phases = {
    'Spring (50-110)': (50, 110),
    'Summer (111-180)': (111, 180),
    'Early Fall (181-260)': (181, 260),
    'Late Fall (261-330)': (261, 330)
}

for phase_name, (doy_min, doy_max) in phases.items():
    phase_data = trips[(trips['fish_date_doy'] >= doy_min) & (trips['fish_date_doy'] <= doy_max)]
    total_trips = len(phase_data)
    total_yt = phase_data['yt'].sum()
    avg_yt = phase_data['yt'].mean() if total_trips > 0 else 0
    print(f"{phase_name}: {total_trips} trips, {total_yt} YT, avg {avg_yt:.2f}/trip")
